question: In a certain code language, 'BYE’ is coded as '245' and 'OLA' is coded as '265'. How will 'CAR' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (5) is multiplied by the sum of the position values of the opposite letter according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'BYE’ is coded as '245'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2771551a10449a1357cf634152145cfe7388b499d111d11d6109e9525812195.png] 

And,

 
• 'OLA' is coded as '265'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d53a2c10878c4942b87aaa602888b5e33c35331927a6d7523c7c172d4e303d9e.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• 'CAR' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4909d7e3b46160a569d516f10ef524f03f3694aa47fce0670293baa4b90fd247.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "295".
